title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 049
review_goal: Differentiate cellphone, certificate, and cloud variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Tall smartphone outline with a blank screen and one small bottom button
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain smartphone with a blank screen and tiny bottom button.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the speaker slot phone when the top earpiece should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a simple tall phone frame with only a tiny square button at the bottom.

items.depicts_observation: Tall phone screen with a top speaker slot and one round home button
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a phone with both a top speaker slot and a round lower button.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the blank phone when the frame should stay free from top speaker details.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a top speaker pill and a round home button inside the same phone outline.

items.depicts_observation: Eight pointed seal badge with one centered check mark
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a seal badge shape with one centered approval check.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the document with ribbon medal when the outer shape should stay rectangular.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a star edged badge rather than a paper document.

items.depicts_observation: Document frame with two text lines and one ribbon medal at lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a paper certificate with text lines and a ribbon seal attached.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the star seal badge when the icon should not look like a full document page.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot combines a page frame, short text lines, and one medal ribbon at the corner.

items.depicts_observation: Puffy cloud outline with one centered tall bump and two rounded side lobes
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic puffy cloud with a tall center dome.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the loop cloud when the outline should curl open on the right side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a full puffy cloud outline with three rounded bumps.
